name: office
description: Essential office suite (LibreOffice), PDF reader (Evince), dictionaries and calendar
_comment: Note: LibreOffice, Evince PDF, aspell dictionaries, and GNOME Calendar are default. Extra tools (AbiWord, Gnumeric, Scribus, Okular, MuPDF, Calcurse) are listed under 'optional_packages' for easy user enablement.
